notes: Master's: 301 rows recorded = 70 USTC rows (the 69 research fields of the Chinese-taught list plus the MBA that is only on the English-taught list; USTC states 70 master's programmes) and 231 UCAS rows (distinct major names from the 312 entries of the UCAS majors page; 79 names appear several times under different subject codes and all codes are kept in the row detail).
Doctorate: 82 USTC rows = the doctoral programmes (research fields) of the Chinese-taught list, matching the 82 that USTC states. The English-taught doctoral list is a subset of it.

The UCAS page does not say which level each of its 312 entries belongs to; the 2026 UCAS notice points to this page for its English-instructed master's programmes, so the list is recorded at master's level. UCAS publishes no separate list of English-instructed doctoral programmes for international students; the Chinese admission site holds domestic catalogues that were not used.

Two entries on the UCAS page were left out because they are not majors: 54655 (code 090707) and Institute of Process Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences (code 081701). Spellings such as Materialogy and Resouces are the page's own.

USTC Chinese-taught programmes need an HSK level 4 certificate or higher (waiver possible); programmes marked * (MBA, Master of Public Management) need a bachelor's degree obtained before 31 August 2024 (as printed in the 2027 list).

USTC lists are the 2027 admission lists; the CAS-ANSO 2026 call is closed. UCAS and USTC are the two host universities the call names; students may also study at CAS institutes (98 institutes and 17 UCAS colleges are listed on the UCAS site) but the sources give no separate programme list per institute.
